properties.name: Hama Project
properties.site: Università degli Studi di Milano | Natioanl Museum of Denmark | Hama
properties.description: Ordinary Lives in Extraordinary Times: A New View of the Earliest Urban Societies in Bronze Age Syria

properties.name: Big-DEA
properties.site: Università degli Studi di Milano | Ebla Region
properties.description: “Big Data and Early Archives (Big-DEA). Measuring Settlement Dynamics and Environmental Exploitation in the Ebla Region during the 3rd Millennium BC: Archaeological Record, Cuneiform Texts, and Remote Sensing (PRIN 2017)”

properties.name: Ciclovia del Sole
properties.description: Aerophotogrammetric survey of strategic areas for the design of the "Ciclovia del Sole," delivering outputs that included point clouds, digital terrain models (DTM), and floor plans generated in a GIS environment.

properties.name: Superbonus 110%
properties.description: Drone-based photogrammetric surveys of various residential buildings for the Superbonus 110% design, in collaboration with Eco Care Building. Additionally, CAD renderings of the elevations and floor plans were produced.

properties.name: Archaeological map of the Province of Monza and Brianza
properties.description: erophotogrammetric survey by drone of several sites of probable archaeological interest, in order to further the investigations for the creation of the archaeological map of the Province of Monza and Brianza.

properties.name: Ponte di Olina
properties.description: Integrated laser scanning and drone photogrammetry survey of the Olina bridge, for the purpose of planning the restoration interventions. In collaboration with the engineering firm LEONI E BONI srl.

properties.name: Drone-based photogrammetric survey of the Old Bridge in Introd
properties.description: Survey aimed not only at preparing educational panels but also at drafting a future restoration project. Therefore, after the field survey activities, an interpretative stratigraphic analysis of the structure was conducted at a reproduction scale of 1:20

properties.name: SS 79 Ternana
properties.description: Planimetric and altimetric topographic survey using GNSS (GPS) and a Total Station of an 18 km section of SS 79 Ternana near Rieti for a road barrier rehabilitation project.

properties.name: Plano-altimetric Survey
properties.description: Planimetric and altimetric topographic survey using GNSS (GPS) and a Total Station of a section of road and stream near Sasso Marconi (BO) for a road deviation project and bridge design.

properties.name: Sestri Levante - Recco gas pipeline
properties.description: Drone photogrammetric surveys of four areas of archaeological interest as part of the Sestri Levante - Recco gas pipeline project, with the delivery of a 3D model, DEM, contour lines, and orthophotos, as well as aerial photographic documentation.

properties.name: Monte Croce Guardia
properties.description: Aerophotogrammetric survey of the Monte Croce Guardia summit, near an area of archaeological interest under investigation, with the delivery of a 3D model, DEM, contour lines, and an orthophoto.

properties.name: Castello Vecchio
properties.description: Drone-based photogrammetric survey of the Old Castle in Pont-Saint-Martin aimed at drafting a restoration project, with restitution of nadir ortophoto and ortophotos of the elevations of the walls
